decisions.reason: The encrypted second-channel communication sits at the core of the firm's authentication and cryptography know-how and matches its strategic direction toward binding mobile communication, so the firm can keep interpreting results and improving it.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture gained a page of its own in 2019 and draws directly on the firm's deep cryptography and SDK expertise, making it a well-absorbed platform worth continued R&D investment.

The QR-code hardware signature token is close to the firm's established offer and was promoted to its own page, and the firm's hardware and transaction-signing knowledge lets it learn from market feedback, though hardware margins carry some risk.

The payment security compliance suite builds on existing regulatory and authentication expertise demanded by banking customers, but its lower visibility suggests it is more peripheral, so dropping it remains a moderate risk.
